subject: MANDATORY: regression continuity + Gen7 PRIVATE_FROST/video passthrough precedence
body: All active agents must carry the current regression-baseline digest in each service checkpoint and cannot silently drop prior accepted outputs/tests. Gen7 render precedence is PRIVATE_FROST > VIDEO_PASSTHROUGH > PUBLIC_GLASS. Screenshot-blocked/FLAG_SECURE/work-profile/private/unknown-sensitive content is procedural PRIVATE_FROST with zero protected-pixel materialization. Public content with positive exact-current active-video evidence may suppress decorative glass, but video never overrides secure/private classification and package name alone is insufficient.
